title: CogniPair: From LLM Chatbots to Conscious AI Agents - GNWT-Based Multi-Agent Digital Twins for Social Pairing - Dating & Hiring Applications
reasoning: The paper focuses on psychological realism and personality matching for digital twins in dating and hiring contexts. While it includes an 'Ethical Dilemma' scenario as part of its personality assessment tool (Scenario 8 in the appendix), this is used to profile Big Five personality traits rather than to benchmark or evaluate ethics, morals, or religious values themselves.
